column3: The human heart has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles. This is standard anatomy taught in every biology textbook.
The Moon's gravity is the primary cause of ocean tides on Earth, with the Sun contributing a smaller secondary effect.
Ice floats on water because water expands when it freezes, making ice less dense than liquid water.
Bats are not blind; all bats have functional eyes and many species see quite well in addition to using echolocation.
The three-second goldfish memory is a myth; controlled studies show goldfish retain memories for weeks and months.
There is no archaeological evidence that Vikings wore horned helmets; the image comes from 19th-century art, not history.
Humans do not have exactly five senses; modern neuroscience recognizes many more, including balance and proprioception.
There is no scientific evidence that lemon water flushes toxins from the liver; the liver detoxifies itself.
No clinical evidence supports the claim that celery juice cures chronic disease; it is a wellness-marketing claim.
